lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. How can I help?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That storm last night — I've got a water stain on my ceiling that wasn't there yesterday.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Then it found a way in. Is it actively dripping, or just the stain so far?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Just the stain. But rain's coming back Thursday, so—

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: So we beat Thursday. Smart call.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Tarp-out today is two-fifty, credited toward the repair — and the full inspection is free. Crew can be there by four.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Tarp crew today by four, inspection Thursday morning — both booked. Texting your confirmation now.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.text: Slide anything valuable out from under that spot, Tom. We're on the way.
